scenes.description: Elliot Jordan sits at a corner table with his friend Chen and Chen's mother, discussing his upcoming job in the artificial intelligence industry. The atmosphere is calm, but Elliot's unease is palpable.

characters.name: Elliot Jordan
characters.description: A 24-year-old Artificial Intelligence Industry Practitioner facing a career transition. He is thoughtful, anxious, and ambitious, but plagued by self-doubt.; Male, Entering a New Career Stage, 24 years old; Occupation: Artificial Intelligence Industry Practitioner; Personality: Anxious, Thoughtful, Ambitious, Self-doubting; Values: Career Growth, Authenticity, Trust; Interests: Career Development, Personal Reflection, Friendship; Experiences: Recent Career Transition, Friendship with Supportive Friends, Family Influence on Career Choices, Uncertainty in New Environments, Seeking Validation

characters.name: Chen
characters.description: Elliot's supportive and optimistic friend; Male; Age: 24; Occupation: Part-time barista at a local coffee shop; Personality: Reassuring, cheerful, empathetic; Values: Loyalty, kindness, work-life balance; Interests: Coffee culture, indie music, helping others; Experiences: Graduated from university last year, worked in customer service during college, supported a close friend through a major life transition.
characters.position: Across from Elliot, holding a coffee cup

characters.name: Chen's Mother
characters.description: A firm but kind woman in her 50s who values hard work and perseverance; Female; Age: 54; Occupation: Owner of a local bakery; Personality: Supportive, pragmatic, warm; Values: Family, resilience, community; Interests: Cooking, reading business journals, gardening; Experiences: Built her bakery from scratch during tough economic times, helped raise Chen while managing her business, mentors young entrepreneurs in the neighborhood.
characters.position: Sitting next to Chen, holding a pastry

actions.action: Expresses anxiety about the new job
actions.dialogue: I just don't know if I'm ready for this. I mean, I've always wanted to grow in my career, but this feels like a huge leap.
You've worked so hard to get here, Elliot. This is a chance to be authentic and grow. You've got this.
You've already made it to the starting line, son. Now you just have to run. Trust yourself and the people who believe in you.
I guess I'm just worried about deviating from my original plan. What if I'm not good enough?
Remember when I switched from engineering to hospitality? It felt like a waste at first, but now it's helping me learn more about people and adaptability.
You trust your friends, your family, and your values. That's what will carry you through the uncertainty.

scenes.plot: Elliot is on the verge of starting a new job in the AI industry and is struggling with self-doubt and anxiety about straying from his original career path. His friend Chen and Chen's mother offer support and encouragement, helping him reflect on his values and experiences.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate Elliot's inner conflict and how his values of authenticity, trust, and career growth are challenged and reinforced through interactions with supportive friends and family.
